title: Claude Code drives AI service launches with lead scraping and #ClaudeCode #AIlaunch #aiautomation
description: Claude Code showed how to use AI to build a million-dollar business from scratch. By leveraging AI tools to create a service website, scrape leads, generate sales scripts, and develop products, entrepreneurs can streamline the entire business launch process. This approach emphasizes selling the service before investing any capital, reducing financial risk and accelerating growth. It highlights a practical use of AI automation for local business outreach and product fulfillment, showcasing a new frontier in AI-driven startups. The method demonstrates how AI can transform traditional sales and development workflows, making it easier for individuals to build scalable businesses with minimal upfront costs. #ClaudeCode #AIautomation #AIsales #AIBusiness #LocalBusinessAI #AIleadgeneration #Startups #Entrepreneurship #BusinessGrowth #AIscripts #ProductDevelopment #AItools #MillionDollarBusiness #SalesAutomation #AIforBusiness
